# `operations.CreditReapplied`

A previously-unapplied credit was reapplied once a live destination existed ([ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md) slot 5). The account that could not receive the payout became receivable again (re-opened, reactivated, or a re-target to a valid account), so the held IOU is discharged and the money lands. A CROSS-CUTTING engine-declared event declared once in the spine under the synthetic `operations` aggregate_type (event-store §4.3), folded per family as a no-op (the IOU/escheat ledger is spine-owned). The resolution key is a PURE FUNCTION of the original intent: resolution_intent_id = g(original_intent_id) from SettlementReferences.DeriveResolutionIntentId, never freshly minted, so a late apply of the ORIGINAL credit and this resolution structurally reference the same intent and the CA-apply command_id collapses at command_dedup to ONE landing (the double-pay guard, [ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md) §Idempotency). A second CreditReapplied for an already-resolved intent is a reconciliation signal, not a double-pay. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2) — opaque refs, integer cents, an input date.

## Payload fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `resolution_intent_id` | `string` | The resolution key g(original_intent_id) from SettlementReferences.DeriveResolutionIntentId — derived from the original intent, NEVER fresh (the structural double-pay guard). A structural token, never PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `original_intent_id` | `string` | The original economic-intent id whose unapplied credit this resolves (from the matching CreditUnapplied) — a structural token, never PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `beneficiary_account_ref` | `string` | The opaque account the reapplied credit lands on (the now-live destination, possibly re-targeted) — a reference the engine resolves internally, NEVER an IBAN/PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `amount_cents` | `long` | The reapplied amount as integer EUR cents (Money.Cents, [ADR-PC-010](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-010-dotnet-hand-rolled-engine.md) §P1) — equals the held amount unless a partial resolution policy applies. |
| `reapplied_at` | `int` (`date`) | ReappliedAt (DateOnly) as days since epoch — the economic date the credit was reapplied, a command-supplied input, never a clock read ([ADR-PC-023](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-023-temporal-signals-projection-derived.md)). |
